rows.canonical_name: 4.2BSD TCP (1983) -- the pre-congestion-control TCP that collapsed the Internet in 1986
rows.lineage: TCP congestion-control lineage, the KNOWN-BAD ancestor: 4.2BSD's TCP (Bill Joy, Sam Leffler) had retransmission timers and windows but NO congestion window, NO slow start and a crude RTT estimate. In October 1986 the LBL-to-Berkeley path fell from 32 kbit/s to 40 bit/s -- congestion collapse -- which is the pressure that produced 4.3BSD-Tahoe's algorithms (Jacobson 1988). Preserved from the unix-history-repo (Spinellis) at tag BSD-4_2.
rows.human_purpose: deliver a reliable byte stream over an unreliable internet using windows and retransmission timers
rows.version: 4.2BSD (released Aug 1983), sys/netinet/tcp_*.{c,h}; unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_2

rows.canonical_name: 4.3BSD-Reno TCP (1990) -- fast retransmit and fast recovery
rows.lineage: TCP congestion-control lineage, the SUCCESSOR: Reno keeps Tahoe's slow start/avoidance and adds fast retransmit on three duplicate ACKs and fast recovery (halve cwnd instead of collapsing to one segment). 'Reno' is the name later analyses (Fall & Floyd 1996) attach to this behaviour; NewReno, SACK, CUBIC descend from it. Preserved from unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_3_Reno.
rows.human_purpose: recover from a single lost segment without draining the pipe: retransmit on duplicate ACKs and keep sending at half rate
rows.version: 4.3BSD-Reno (June 1990), sys/netinet/tcp_*.{c,h}; unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_3_Reno

rows.canonical_name: 4.3BSD-Tahoe TCP (1988) -- slow start, congestion avoidance, Karn's algorithm, RTT variance (Jacobson/Karels)
rows.lineage: TCP congestion-control lineage, the HISTORICAL REDESIGN: Van Jacobson and Mike Karels added a congestion window (snd_cwnd), slow start, congestion avoidance (additive increase / multiplicative decrease), Karn's retransmission-timer rule and the mean+variance RTT estimator to 4.3BSD-Tahoe in response to the 1986 collapse. Preserved from unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_3_Tahoe.
rows.human_purpose: make every sender probe for its share of a shared link and back off multiplicatively when loss signals congestion
rows.version: 4.3BSD-Tahoe (June 1988), sys/netinet/tcp_*.{c,h}; unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_3_Tahoe
